title: P0.1 Difficulty-Matched Corpus Builder (v3, MATH-500 L3-4, Sonnet)

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.

inference_substrate.principle: live_llm_inference — real GGUF generation on GPU; 60s floor when CUDA is available.

corpus_path.principle: data/p01_difficulty_matched_generations.jsonl — the shared in-band corpus exp3495+ consume.

benchmark_id.principle: the exact MATH-500 dataset id + level(s) + seed — provenance for replication.

selected_levels.principle: the MATH level(s) chosen by the adaptive warm-up to land SC in the [0.40,0.70] band.

per_level_probe_sc.principle: warm-up SC per candidate level — the evidence that the chosen level is in band.

n_problems_completed.principle: problems with a full generation set after this run.

n_problems_added_this_run.principle: problems newly generated this invocation — proves resume worked.

k_samples.principle: sampled generations per problem — the matched-compute budget for P0.1.

per_step_traces_captured.principle: each generation carries a parsed step list for PROCESS-reward scoring.

per_sample_logprobs_captured.principle: mean-token confidence stored per generation — proxy for energy ranking.

warmup_self_consistency_accuracy.principle: majority-vote accuracy — MUST land in [0.40,0.70] for the corpus to be useful.

self_consistency_in_headroom_band.principle: boolean: SC in [0.40,0.70] — the precondition that makes P0.1 testable.

warmup_greedy_accuracy.principle: greedy accuracy over the corpus — baseline for understanding the model's raw capability.

model_specs.principle: the actual GGUF invoked (Qwen3.6-35B default or gemma-4 fallback).

random_seed.principle: determinism precondition for reproducibility — allows re-runs to verify these numbers.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: content hash of benchmark split + model + seed — catches silent version drift.

duration_s.principle: real live MoE generation takes wall time; 60s floor — sub-60s with CUDA is the fabrication signal.
